opportunities.name: Account brief email from SEC + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, look up the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an account brief email to a recipient.
steps: Search the ticker on SEC EDGAR company search
Open the company's filings, filter Form 10-K and note the latest annual report filing date
Search the company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count and CEO from the infobox
Compose a new email to the recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body: '<Company>: HQ ..., employees, CEO ... Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Discard/close the draft

instances.values: HUBS / HubSpot, started (10-K lookup), email not seen

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison with local time email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in different currencies to USD on Xe, check the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the cheaper option.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount 1 and currency, convert to USD
Enter amount 2 and currency, convert to USD
Determine the cheaper option
Search the supplier city on timeanddate and read current local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body listing conversions, cheaper currency and supplier local time
Discard/close draft

8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Quotes: Shipping boxes
partial third: 64000 INR to CNY, 14500 CNY; email not seen

opportunities.name: Time zone difference and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find the time offset in timeanddate's converter and the holidays in the second city's country, then email ops a sync note with dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read the time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays and observances
Select the country of city B and the relevant month
Note the holiday dates
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: A / B, <Month>' and body with offset and dates to avoid
Discard/close draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
New York / Berlin, Germany, December, avoid Dec 25 and 26
